name: collagen type XII alpha 1 chain

function.text: COL12A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(XII) chain. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength. It participates in collagen fibril organization and endodermal cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy 2 (autosomal recessive); Bethlem myopathy 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from LiferaOmics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
